package.limits: Full optimized suite and universal package on this host. Synthetic native canvas events/offscreen rendering are not live desktop or physical Intel/macOS14/macOS26 tests. Xcode project unchanged; new files use existing synchronized groups.

api.parameters: layerID, settings, optional enabled/pathID. settings replace the full layout with native defaults for omitted fields: mode, width/height, path, warp style/bend/horizontalDistortion/verticalDistortion/vertical, fit, start/end, reverse, offset, wordSpacing/lineSpacing. enabled=false removes geometry and takes no settings/pathID.
api.coordinates: Logical type pixels before layer affine transform. start/end are fractions of baseline length. pathID copies document path coordinates into the logical type frame. Later saved-path edits are independent.
api.state: layers[].text.geometry and capabilities.text.layout expose settings, schemas, limits, persistence and qualification.
api.guards: Authentication/share/revision/interaction/locks and prepared-operation cancellation/revocation; invalid settings400; stale/busy409. Desktop and API share an atomic type command that compensates normalized bounds without moving the logical anchor or mask.

adobe_api.scope: Existing native text/job engine preserved. No dedicated shaped-text fields or endpoint in the pinned contract, so no invented Adobe route.
adobe_api.limits: Editable shaped PSD output rejects explicitly; flattened image export remains available. No Adobe output/font/composer equivalence claimed.

limitations: Full T04 remains open: exact Photoshop fit/composers/preset formulas and raster equality are unqualified.
Vertical shaped type and color/bitmap glyphs without vector outlines reject. Fonts and glyph/font variants require broader qualification.
The native rich-text pane edits content beside a curved preview; live curved caret/IME and direct draggable path delimiters are deferred.
Saved paths are copied; not live-linked. Semantic Actions recording of arbitrary type edits, full PSD forms and cross-application interchange remain open.
Synthetic/offscreen AppKit and host tests only; no unlocked desktop, independent Photoshop output or physical Intel/macOS14/macOS26 qualification.
next: F06: native Filter Gallery with effect categories, editable stacks, preview/history/Smart Filters and APIs. Minor typography utilities and exact/cosmetic refinements remain deferred.
